tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Find electric vehicles by brand or model name, or list the whole catalog ranked for a use case, optionally only those with at least a given range. Use it first whenever you have a name but no slug, and for questions like 'which EVs go furthest' or 'best family EV'. Returns JSON: per model the slug (

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Everything SuliHuli holds on one electric vehicle: range per test cycle (WLTP, EPA, CLTC, NEDC), charging, efficiency, battery and the other specs, prices per market and version with their dates, and every figure's source link, date and status (verified or unverified; where sources disagree, each fi

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two to four electric vehicles: range (each with its test cycle), charging, battery, price and the other specs, the leading value marked per row, a short verdict, the version each column stands for, sources and cover photo credits. Each model is compared on its named versio

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The published 'best EV for ...' rankings (everyday, long range, long range over 500 km, family, performance): slug, title, the preset each ranks by and what it optimizes for, and the page URL. Use it to pick a ranking, then open it with get_category_ranking. Returns JSON.

tools.name: get_category_ranking
tools.description: One 'best EV for ...' ranking: the top 25 models in order with score out of 100, published range with its test cycle, DC charging 10-80 % time and battery (unverified figures marked with their source), the public ranking method, and links to each model.
